cards.card_text: If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, what does Jesus say about the members of his household?

cards.card_text: Jesus is sending out His twelve disciples, and He's been honest with them: if people called the head of the house Beelzebul, they'll call His household worse.
cards.verse_text: If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!
cards.snippet: If the head of the house has been called Beelzebul, how much more the members of his household!

cards.card_text: They say, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.” Jesus knows their thoughts, and He answers with a picture: a kingdom divided against itself.
cards.verse_text: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.” Knowing their thoughts, Jesus said to them, “Every kingdom divided against itself will be laid waste, and every city or household divided against itself will not stand.
cards.snippet: But when the Pharisees heard this, they said, “Only by Beelzebul, the prince of demons, does this man drive out demons.” Knowing their…

cards.card_text: Then Jesus flips it: if He drives out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do the Pharisees' own sons drive them out?
cards.verse_text: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out?
cards.snippet: And if I drive out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do your sons drive them out?

cards.card_text: They're saying Jesus is possessed by Beelzebul, and they've got an explanation for how He drives out demons.
cards.verse_text: And the scribes who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”
cards.snippet: …who had come down from Jerusalem were saying, “He is possessed by Beelzebul,” and, “By the prince of the demons He drives out demons.”

cards.card_text: Some in the crowd say Jesus drives out demons by Beelzebul.
cards.verse_text: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”
cards.snippet: but some of them said, “It is by Beelzebul, the prince of the demons, that He drives out demons.”

cards.card_text: Then Jesus asks: if He drives out demons by Beelzebul, by whom do their own sons drive them out?
cards.verse_text: After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
cards.snippet: After all, you say that I drive out demons by Beelzebul.
